lead_fa: Restoration شفای HoT-محور است: با لایه‌لایه کردن Rejuvenation و Lifebloom گروه را برای آسیب‌های پیوسته آماده می‌کنی و با [[Regrowth]] که از HoTها قدرت می‌گیرد شفای مستقیم می‌دهی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Keeper of the Grove]] با Grove Guardianها برای برست شفایی و [[Wildstalker]] با پروفایل تک‌هدفی قوی و هم‌افزایی با Everbloom.

strengths: Impactful cooldowns: Tranquility, Incarnation: Tree of Life, Convoke the Spirits
Can concentrate HoTs on one ally for excellent sustained single-target healing
Great mobility plus mobility cooldowns; strong sustained healing
Outstanding survivability, especially for a healer
weaknesses: A lot of upkeep and moving pieces; difficult to master
Fewer responses to unpredictable burst; mid-level spot healing

key_changes: 12.1 simplifies core playstyle, especially in raid; you play similarly to 12.0 with a larger emphasis on Regrowth
Abundance was redesigned: while you have at least 5 Rejuvenations active, Regrowth becomes cheaper with a high Crit chance

hero.recommendation: Both trees are fairly passive with new gameplay hooks; Keeper of the Grove wins burst healing (multiple Grove Guardians at once) and defense (Protective Growth); Wildstalker has a strong single-target profile and great synergy with the Everbloom apex, plus extra damage from Cat Form (optional).
hero.keeper_of_the_grove: Burst healing via stacking Grove Guardians; Protective Growth for defense.
hero.wildstalker: Strong single-target healing, Everbloom synergy, and considerable added damage if you spend time in Cat Form (not required).

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Restoration Druid Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/druid/restoration/talent-builds-pve-healer), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Swiftmend casts: even 100% overheal Swiftmends are high value because of attached effects (Grove Guardians, Reforestation, Everbloom, Implant).
Utilize Abundance: put Rejuvenation out on the group before or as damage hits so follow-up Regrowths are cheap with high Crit chance; this is the heart of the playstyle and mana efficiency.
Use major cooldowns: cast Convoke the Spirits / Incarnation: Tree of Life and Tranquility very often; pre-plan them for difficult moments.

rotation.raid_everbloom: Maintain Lifebloom on yourself plus multiple HoTs like 2x Rejuvenation; Swiftmend yourself on cooldown; a Regrowth HoT on yourself is automatic via Rampant Growth. All of this maximizes Everbloom healing.
rotation.raid_abundance: Keep five Rejuvenation buffs active to maintain Abundance, then cast Regrowth to exploit it. Batch Rejuvenation casts together instead of one by one. Pressing Swiftmend before Rejuvenation makes the next cast spread three HoTs instead of one, keeping Abundance active cheaply.
rotation.raid_wild_growth: Wild Growth is high-HPS and high-cost: push it when the raid is in danger; it is your primary mana throttle, so cut casts from safe moments if running out of mana. Avoid generically casting it whenever available.
rotation.nature_swiftness: Nature's Swiftness greatly increases your next Regrowth's healing; with the Overgrowth talent, self-cast it during dangerous moments.
rotation.hoT_refresh: You can refresh any HoT with less than ~5-6 seconds remaining with no penalty.
rotation.cooldowns: Tranquility, Incarnation: Tree of Life and Convoke the Spirits should be pre-planned and used often; line them up with the fight's hardest phases.

gear.gearing_rules: Haste > Mastery > Versatility > Critical Strike; Intellect/ilvl upgrades still win. Use QE Live for accuracy. The BiS combines overbudget raid items (Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang) with mastery/haste-heavy offpieces; clear the raid on heroic at least for the special items.

tier_set.name: Bark of the Enigmatic Dreamwatcher
tier_set.pc2: Rejuvenation has a 15% chance to grant Genesis, causing all your heal over time effects to heal for 15% more for 8 sec; multiple applications overlap.
tier_set.pc4: Nature's Swiftness, Tranquility, Incarnation: Tree of Life, and Convoke the Spirits have a 100% chance to grant Genesis; Genesis duration increased by 8 sec. Does not proc off Reforestation.
tier_set.note: A decent overall healing bonus that does not require heavy play-around; expect about 10-15% healing from it.

catalyst: Vestment of the Awakening (Nez'kali the Soulcoiler)

notes: Haste > Mastery > Versatility > Critical Strike as a rough guideline.
Do not neglect Intellect: substantial item level increases generally win.
Use QE Live for the most accurate gearing.

flasks: Flask of the Blood Knights (all raid fights)
consumables.combat_potion: Potion of Recklessness (preferred) / Lightfused Mana Potion (situational, raiding)

enchants.head: Enchant Helm - Empowered Hex of Leeching
enchants.chest: Enchant Chest - Mark of the Worldsoul

mplus.hero_note: Keeper of the Grove and Wildstalker both carry Best tags in M+ depending on the mode; Wildstalker's single-target profile suits tank healing in keys.
tips: Layer Rejuvenation during the gather so Regrowth stays cheap when damage lands.
Swiftmend early and often: its attached effects (Grove Guardians, Reforestation, Implant) make it valuable even as overheal.
Shapeshifting (Cat/Bear for mobility and utility) is part of the M+ playstyle.
